title: Finite generic trace injection and prime filtration data
statement: Let k be algebraically closed and C/k a smooth integral affine connected curve [def-sc-curves], with generic inclusion eta and function field K [def-sc-function-field]. Assume every finite extension L/K has a finite normalization model C_L [def-fin-normalization-extension] that is smooth affine connected over k, with generic field identified with L compatibly over C. For a torsion generic abelian etale sheaf M [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf] with finite geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], there are finitely many smooth integral affine connected curves D_i/k and finite generic chains F_i(0)=0,...,F_i(n_i). Each successive step is a short exact sequence with first and second terms identified with consecutive chain terms and third term identified with the constant Z/ell sheaf [def-sc-constant-sheaves] for a prime ell. H²(C,eta_*M) [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] injects into the product of H²(D_i,eta_i*F_i(n_i)). No cohomology vanishing assumption is made.

proof.text: Identify M with its finite continuous Galois module via the stalk equivalence. Decompose into finitely many invariant primary summands.

For each ell-primary summand choose the prime-to-ell-index open subgroup and invariant filtration with finite trivial F_ell quotients. Refine each quotient by a basis, pull back the one-dimensional flag, and transport the resulting rank-one constant quotients to generic sheaves through the equivalence.

Take the finite separable fixed field L of the open subgroup. Restriction followed by trace is multiplication by [L:K]. Since this is prime to ell, Bezout rescaling with an annihilating power of ell gives a retraction.

Apply hmodel to L and identify its spectrum with the generic point of the normalization D. Composition of direct images identifies the pushed-forward restriction with the finite direct image of the terminal filtration term. Exact finite pushforward and its cohomology comparison transport the retraction to an injection into H² on D.

Finite direct sums are preserved by additive direct image and cohomology. Combine the primary injections using their decomposition projections. Encode the chains by F_i(a), with initial zero term and short exact prime constant quotients. For the zero module use r=0 and the empty product.

theorem exists_generic_finite_trace_filtration_data
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C] [IsIntegral C]
    (hmodel : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra C.functionField L]
      [FiniteDimensional C.functionField L],
      IsFinite (C.fromNormalizationIn L) ∧ IsAffine (C.normalizationIn L) ∧
        IsConnectedCurve (C.fromNormalizationIn L ≫ f) ∧
        Smooth (C.fromNormalizationIn L ≫ f) ∧
        ∃ e : Spec (.of L) ≅ Spec (C.normalizationIn L).functionField,
          e.hom ≫ (C.normalizationIn L).fromSpecFunctionField =
            (C.fromSpecOfAlgebraFunctionField L).toNormalization)
    (M : Sheaf (Spec C.functionField).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hM : M.IsTorsion)
    (hfinite : Finite (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap C.functionField (AlgebraicClosure C.functionField))))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M)) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (D : Fin r → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, D i ⟶ Spec (.of k)),
      (∀ i, IsConnectedCurve (g i)) ∧ (∀ i, Smooth (g i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsAffine (D i)) ∧
      ∃ hIntegral : ∀ i, IsIntegral (D i),
      letI : ∀ i, IsIntegral (D i) := hIntegral;
      ∃ (n : Fin r → ℕ)
        (F : ∀ i, ℕ → Sheaf (Spec (D i).functionField).smallEtaleTopology
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
        (∀ i, IsZero (F i 0)) ∧
        (∀ i (a : ℕ), a < n i →
          ∃ (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Spec (D i).functionField).smallEtaleTopology
              AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) (ℓ : ℕ),
            ℓ.Prime ∧ S.ShortExact ∧ Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ F i a) ∧
              Nonempty (S.X₂ ≅ F i (a + 1)) ∧
              Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ (Spec (D i).functionField).constantZMod ℓ)) ∧
        ∃ j : Sheaf.H
          ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} C.fromSpecFunctionField).obj M) 2 →
          ∀ i, Sheaf.H
            ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D i).fromSpecFunctionField).obj
              (F i (n i))) 2,
          Function.Injective j
